confirmedFacts: Input status: non-production workflow comparison; every generated artifact is a draft.
Laka project documents use Chinese for product background, business rules, PRD, decision reasons, and acceptance criteria.
App-facing UI copy defaults to English unless an existing backend prototype uses Chinese operational labels.
Laka is an adult stranger-social product for overseas markets, centered on MENA, with 1v1 chat, voice rooms, gifts, coins, and diamonds.
Requirement version is v0.6, Draft, Proposed, last updated 2026-07-21.
Existing requirement files include README.md, PRD.md, prototype.html, announcement-prototype.html, Axhub files, 8 screenshots, and 3 announcement wireframe assets.
PRD.md has 307 lines; prototype.html has 155 lines; announcement-prototype.html has 70 lines.
v0.6 preserves the existing gift resource library and separates gift tabs, gift placement, badge assets, play configuration, and gift-information banners.
The backend must not include an independent all-server announcement configuration page.
Gift play configuration supports one primary play type per gift: normal, lucky, global, music, cp, or guardian.
Global gift announcements use single successful send amount threshold; Lucky announcements use final win amount threshold.
Badges are reusable assets selected as multi-select labels in gift play configuration; one gift can have multiple badges.
Gift-information Banner supports template and custom types; Banner click opens the bound gift detail page.
Announcement UI must cover gift sent and Lucky win cases in the voice-room top safe area.

Migration must map old group names to stable Tabs, migrate old gift types to play configuration, dedupe badges into a badge library, migrate announcement thresholds into play fields, and preserve fallback to old read logic during gray release.
DECISIONS.md was read and is empty.
No exact CLI token usage was available.
